note: THE KERNEL'S STATE SPACE THAT NO PASS WALKS — each key with the reason it may stand unwalked ('' = nobody has said yet). Rewritten by `node scripts/kernel-walked.mjs <passes…> --write`: a key the passes walked leaves, the reasons are kept. FREEZE ZERO, stage 4.

flows.step:colony-resolution-release-owed: FAILURE PATH — raised only when the release of a colony resolution's outcome is REFUSED at the resolution's end (`releaseWorkspaceOutcome('resolution-end')`).
flows.step:law-play-fold: DEAD BY READING, ONE RACE UNPROVEN (2026-11-25) — the fold is raised only where an awaiting handoff resolves with the law's card landing and NO claim in the frame; the direct commit places its claim before the emit (`claimLawPlayOutcome`), and the staged door begins no awaiting handoff. Left in place as the guard of the one unproven race (a claim released mid round-trip): without it the workspace would fold under a landing card. To walk: a unit of `resolveAnsweredCommit` with the claim released by hand.
flows.surface:colony-controller: FAILURE PATH (re-read 2026-11-24) — the scope waits only in its two bounded nets: the entry's («entered, and nothing ever arrived», `COLONY_BONUS_ENTRY_WAIT_MS`) and the sequence's («another cycle is owed and nothing of it has arrived», `COLONY_BONUS_CYCLE_WAIT_MS`). The remote colony bonus itself IS walked — `console-colony-remote-bonus` (three tests) and `console-pluto-two-colony-sequence` on every whole suite, the `miranda-remote-bonus` / `pluto-settlements-*` tables under the monkey — and arms neither: the evidence is already there when the viewer walks in, and the next cycle rides the answer of the one before. To walk: the fault pass with the colony's answer HELD between the entry and its first evidence, or between two cycles.
flows.surface:draft-tray: DEAD BY READING (2026-11-25) — the tray mounts only in Phase.INITIALDRAFTING (`draftController.draftTrayMounted`), and no creation path of the product can ask for that phase (the creator sends `initialDraft: false` — `buildCreateGamePayload`; campaigns and rematches copy it; the server's default is false). Its rise half contradicts itself: armed only by a RESEARCH buy, when the tray has already unmounted — and the task host's `riseExtras` with it. Leaves with its code: the component, `draftTrayMounted` and its two pad/bar terms, `riseExtras`, the INITIALDRAFTING terms of `isDraftPick` / `DRAFT_PHASES`, the `.con-drafttray*` rules.
flows.surface:played-controller: DEAD BY READING (2026-11-25) — the played hero's `overlay` host: every entry point of a play resolves to the `workspace` host (a prelude of the start, a deck pick, the staged ritual — hard-coded; the hand's play — the hand frame is always descended and «Разыграно» cannot stand open under a composer; the law's play — the card-actions frame is mounted and the bill is set). The scope's one wait is the departing-card safety of `lifting` under a non-workspace host. Leaves with the `overlay` host: a refactor of `consolePlayedHero` / `ConsolePlayedOverlay`'s hero half, not a deletion of a file.
flows.surface:played-overlay: DEAD BY READING (2026-11-25) — the same `overlay` host as `surface:played-controller`: the overlay's hero frame is measured only for `heroIncoming`, which only an overlay-hosted play raises.

claim.live/arrival: timed → closed: RARE — a GATED retain (the next card outcome of one flow) while the previous batch is still arriving. To walk: a card action whose result draws, retained for a second draw before the first has landed.
claim.live/beat: over → pending: RARE — the execution beat re-armed after it was over: a retained claim's NEXT commit while it still awaits. To walk: a two-commit flow on one claim (a repeat of an action inside one workspace).
claim.live/stage: held → awaiting: FAILURE PATH, second half — `held` is reached only by the claim's SAFETY (8 walks of the broken wire); leaving it by a RETAIN needs the flow to go on after that. To walk: a silent server, then a retained outcome.
claim.live/stage: held → presenting: FAILURE PATH, second half — the artifact arriving AFTER the claim's safety put it in `held`: a late answer behind a broken wire. To walk: the fault pass with the answer released after the safety.
claim.live/stage: presentingOwed → awaiting: RARE — a release REFUSED while the claim presents (2 walks reach `presentingOwed`), then the same claim retained for the next outcome before the bound re-asks.

announce.late → acknowledged: RARE — an announce past its bound (9 walks reach `late`) that the player then acknowledges; the walks move on or end first. To walk: stand on an announced question past the bound, then press.
